description.en:
Deletes an object created by the event (character, model, effect...). Its movement slot is freed, and a second object linked to it (probably its bust-up) is deleted too.
During a match, a match player is not deleted: the second argument (default 2) goes to the routine CMND_DELETE_MOTION uses, which removes loaded motions. Linked objects are then removed as above. The events pass true there when they delete models at the end of a match scene.

true once deleted.
null if the object is not found, the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
